items.title: Wall Street Opens Sharply Higher After the S&P 500's Seven-Day Slide
items.summary: Oil Market Daily News Commentary - Wall Street started the Thanksgiving week on a much brighter note. All three major U.S. stock indexes moved sharply higher at Monday's open as investors returned to stocks after a seven-session losing streak for the S&P 500, and crude oil prices eased further after three straight weekly declines. items.title: Merck (MRK) Ties New AI Oncology Discovery Deal To Future Pipeline Growth
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) agreed a new oncology drug discovery collaboration with Isomorphic Labs that centers on advanced AI driven molecule design. The partnership combines Merck's internal oncology data with Isomorphic Labs' computational models to identify and optimize new cancer drug candidates. Both groups plan to use the AI platform across multiple early stage discovery programs, targeting areas where traditional screening has been slow.
